historic_survey.note: A hotel tower at Portsmouth Square, opened as a Holiday Inn, by Clement Chen & Associates with structural engineer T.Y. Lin, Chen-chi Kwan and John Carl Warnecke. Held up as the clearest Brutalist high-rise downtown: board-formed concrete carrying the grain of its formwork, a broad base for the lobby, restaurant and Chinese Cultural Center, and a narrow shaft of hotel rooms. Found eligible for the California Register.
